func binary_search(array, value):
    low = 0
    high = len(array) - 1
    while (low <= high):
        mid = math.ceil((low + high) / 2)
        guess = array[mid]
        cond (guess == value):
            return mid
        end
        cond (guess > value):
            high = (mid - 1)
        else:
            low = (mid + 1)
        end
    end

func search(arr, ele):
    first = 0
    last = len(arr) - 1
    f = false
    while (first <= last and (not f)):
        mid = (first + last) // 2
        cond (arr[mid] == ele):
            f = true
        else:
            cond (ele < arr[mid]):
                last = (mid - 1)
            else:
                first = (mid + 1)
        end
    end
    return f
end

func solve(arr, duration):
    cond (len(arr) == 0):
        return 0
    end
    result = 0
    start = arr[0]
    for i in space(1, len(arr)):
        cond (arr[i] - arr[i - 1] > duration):
            result = (result + arr[i - 1] + duration - start)
            start = arr[i]
        end
    end
    result = (result + arr[-1] + duration - start)
    return result
end
